review_notes: This is a role-only review. No shell thickness, print-section split, seam flange, or mounting feature is present.
A selected quad remains one removable panel unit even though the accepted OBJ stores it as two triangles.
The rear-service plane is a planning reference only; it does not cut the Gate 1 exterior.
Only the panels marked purple in the annotated SVG are removable glow/light-transmitting panels; all former cyan candidates are opaque.
The eye silhouettes traced from the red annotations define the separate translucent eye material; the older cyan eye placeholders are not rendered.
